setting: Human intracranial decoders of speech content, any task (production, attempted, imagined, perceived); precedents from any signal count for novelty; one population of 18 prior decoders used for M06, M07 and M12.

inherited.M01: Passive listening to TIMIT and reenacted film stimuli; perceived-speech ECoG lineage of the same group (Pasley 2012)
inherited.M02: Forced-aligned and hand-corrected phoneme labels of the stimuli
inherited.M03: Per-subject LDA; subject concatenation as offline upper bound
inherited.M05: 256-electrode clinical HD ECoG, 70-150 Hz high gamma; electrode selection by t-test
inherited.M11: TIMIT and Gump stimuli; two Gump speakers
inherited.M13: Implanted clinical grids; averaging and pooling infeasible for prostheses (authors, §4)
